recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, semi-abstract portrait of a face integrated with a guitar neck, characterized by broad, expressive brushstrokes, sharp geometric planes, and a vibrant palette of cerulean, yellow, and red.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical black guitar neck acts as a structural divider on the right third.
The eyes serve as the primary focal points, rendered with realistic detail amidst abstract surroundings.
The face is fragmented into geometric color blocks, blending skin tones with cool blues.
The lower third features a dynamic, wave-like texture of blue and white strokes.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the central and left two-thirds of the frame, while the guitar neck dominates the right vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The right eye and the black verticality of the guitar neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead to the guitar neck, then down to the textured blue base, circling back through the facial planes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with color and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean and Cobalt Blue provide the atmospheric foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (guitar) and White (highlights) provide structural definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cadmium Red (lips/text) and Lemon Yellow (highlights) provide warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and reds contrasts with the pale, high-value skin tones and deep black values.
paletteRestrictions: Limit greens to the iris of the eyes

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed sans-serif and heavy block-shadowed display
letterConstructionRules: Bottom text: Ultra-tall, narrow verticality with uniform stroke width.
Top text: Heavy, slanted block letters with thick outlines and a curved baseline.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text features a perspective-distorted 'O' and 'D' to fit a curved arc.
Bottom text uses extremely tight kerning and elongated stems.

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the upper corner geometry

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy, arched block type and tall, thin condensed type.

preserve: The arch of the top text
The ultra-condensed nature of the bottom text
The red and white color scheme

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the bottom text.
Captures the blocky, athletic feel of the top display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting of a fragmented face in an 80s expressionist style. Use large blocks of cerulean blue, pale skin tones, and a sharp purple shadow on the nose. Include a vertical black guitar neck on the right side with white fret markers. The bottom should have messy, energetic blue and white brushstrokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the top text in a heavy white block font with a black outline, arched upwards in the top right. Apply the bottom text in a tall, thin red condensed sans-serif in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar neck perfectly vertical?
Are the eyes detailed and green?
Is the red text at the bottom ultra-condensed?
Is the top text arched and shadowed?

adjustableVariables: Sharpness of the geometric facial planes
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for painterly texture in the blue areas.
Ensure the eyes are the sharpest part of the image.
Verify the text does not overlap the eyes.
Confirm the color palette is limited to primary-adjacent hues.
Ensure the guitar neck is a solid black anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Abstract Expressionist Portrait + Geometric Color Blocking + Musical Instrument Integration + High-Contrast Typography
